data.dashboardproviders.yaml:
apiVersion: 1
providers:
- disableDeletion: false
  editable: true
  folder: ""
  name: default
  options:
    path: /var/lib/grafana/dashboards/default
  orgId: 1
  type: file
data.datasources.yaml:
apiVersion: 1
datasources:
- access: proxy
  editable: true
  isDefault: true
  name: Prometheus
  type: prometheus
  url: https://prometheus.home.tom-mendy.com
data.grafana.ini:
[analytics]
check_for_updates = true
[auth.generic_oauth]
allow_sign_up = true
api_url = https://authentik.tom-mendy.com/application/o/userinfo/
auth_url = https://authentik.tom-mendy.com/application/o/authorize/
auto_login = true
client_id = grafana
client_secret = $__env{GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET}
enabled = true
name = Authentik
role_attribute_path = contains(groups[*], 'homelab-admins') && 'Admin' || 'Viewer'
role_attribute_strict = true
scopes = openid profile email offline_access
token_url = https://authentik.tom-mendy.com/application/o/token/
use_pkce = true
[log]
mode = console
[paths]
data = /var/lib/grafana/
logs = /var/log/grafana
plugins = /var/lib/grafana/plugins
provisioning = /etc/grafana/provisioning
[plugins]
preinstall_auto_update = false
[server]
domain = grafana.home.tom-mendy.com
root_url = https://grafana.home.tom-mendy.com
[unified_storage]
index_path = /var/lib/grafana-search/bleve
